title: A flat lowers a note
summary: Read the b sign as one fret lower.

steps.title: One fret lower
steps.body:
A **flat** is the b sign after a note letter. It means one half step lower than that letter without a sign. Bb is one fret lower than B on the same string.

**Why it matters:** The same position can have two names: A# is above A, and Bb is below B. Both name the sound at fret 1 on string 5.

steps.title: B becomes Bb
steps.body: Start with B at fret 2 of string 5 and move back to fret 1. That is Bb. Compare A at open to A# at fret 1: A# and Bb are the same pitch, with different names.

items.prompt: Play Bb2. Use any lit position.

steps.title: Two directions, one place
steps.body: Go up from open A to fret 1, then down from B at fret 2 to fret 1. Say A sharp for the first move and B flat for the second.
